question: What liberation occurs when merit and demerit are exhausted and destroyed?
premises: Merit and demerit undergo destruction and exhaustion
Release is from all binding factors
inference: When merit and demerit are exhausted, one is liberated from all bonds.
uncertainties: The word dhanaiḥ is unusual here and may mean bonds rather than wealth.
plain_english: When merit and demerit are destroyed and exhausted, one is liberated from all bonds.
